prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: mythological creature education catalogue. Create one painterly realistic portrait 2:3, coherent rich brushwork and dramatic readable storytelling. No text or watermark. Kuu, the ancestor's son who became a white swan and flew away: one white swan launches away over the Altai river, dominating foreground, as an older shaman father and three remaining adult sons on shore reach farewell hands toward their departing transformed family member. Their grief and recognition make a narrative of kinship, not a wildlife portrait. Swan anatomy stays natural; simple covered steppe clothes are editorial. No half-human hybrid or supernatural beams. No arbitrary glowing effects, colored mist, glyphs or ribbons.
